quotes: We have years of experience in creating epic indoor play centres with soft play at their heart that the whole family can enjoy.
Soft play is defined as an indoor play area where all surfaces and equipment are covered in a soft foam padding.
While often referring to environments specifically designed for very young children, Flip Out offers epic soft play attractions for all ages from Ninja Wipeout to our epic Inflatable Obstacle Course.

The benefits of soft play are many, including cognitive development such as hand-eye coordination and sensory processing, social interaction and advancement of social skills, and physical development in areas like physical strength and agility.
All this AND soft play is just fun!
INDOOR SOFT PLAY IN CROYDON If you are looking for a great soft play centre for a family day out or a birthday party, Flip Out Croydon is ready and waiting.
Discover a huge indoor playground with soft play opportunities for everyone and dedicated party rooms with a range of packages you can book with the click of a button.

Thank you for taking the time to visit us About Us The HALO play café is a place for anyone to join us for some fun, a tea or coffee and bite to eat.
The innovative idea of the play café is to support children and their families when someone sadly dies, encouraging them out of the home to access the bereavement support they may require.
Within the café we offer referrals for further support and whilst you visit us you contribute to our work, with all proceeds going to Halo Children’s Foundation.
